relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: we show that CGRP+ nerve fibers, likely nociceptors, display expanded innervation within the gastrocnemius muscle

key_findings: CGRP+ fibers show expanded innervation of gastrocnemius muscle after complete spinal transection.
CGRP+ fiber volume in muscle correlates with muscle atrophy, hypersensitivity and spinal glial activation.
